define table zdemo_person_01 {

  key mandt  : mandt not null;
  key docnum : j_1bdocnum not null;
  plans      : plans;
  orgeh      : orgeh;
  massn      : massn;
  massg      : massg;
  begda      : begda;
  login      : zdemodt_login;
  email      : zdemodt_email;
  abkrs      : abkrs;
  @AbapCatalog.foreignKey.screenCheck : true
  ansvh      : ansvh
    with foreign key t542a
      where mandt = zdemo_person_01.mandt
        and molga = '37'
        and ansvh = zdemo_person_01.ansvh;
  anred      : anrde
    with value help h_t522t_1
      where anred = zdemo_person_01.anred;
  pernr      : pernr_d;
  vorna      : pad_vorna;
  nachn      : pad_nachn;

  famst      : zdemodt_famst;
  race       : pbr_race;
  gbort      : hrpadbr_city_text;
  gbdep      : gbdep;
  @AbapCatalog.foreignKey.screenCheck : true
  gblnd      : gblnd
    with foreign key t005
      where mandt = zdemo_person_01.mandt
        and land1 = zdemo_person_01.gblnd;
  @AbapCatalog.foreignKey.screenCheck : true
  natio      : natsl
    with foreign key t005
      where mandt = zdemo_person_01.mandt
        and land1 = zdemo_person_01.natio;
  resext     : zdemodt_resext;
  escabr     : zdemodm_educ;
